name: simple-post-preview-monorepo
description: Framework-agnostic social post previews with React and Vue adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @simple-post/preview && npm run build --workspace @simple-post/preview-react && npm run build --workspace @simple-post/preview-vue
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run pack:check
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @simple-post/preview && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @simple-post/preview-react && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @simple-post/preview-vue
